I replied to Ilse in your DM to say I've noted the new 7 July cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork. I told them it stays private: I won't share it with anyone or post it in a channel.

I didn't save it to the shared GBrain notes, because other people can read those, and that would break "keep it between us." The DM itself is the record. GBrain had nothing about this cutoff and nothing that conflicts with it.

I also asked them a question: today is 14 October 2026, so 7 July this year has already passed. Do they mean 7 July 2027?
